label: CommitteePack
description: Compile a Risk Committee pack for Mara Heritage Bank's quarterly review. Synthesise the credit risk, capital adequacy, operational risk, and concentration-risk material on the platform into a single Risk Committee deliverable. Cover: NPL trajectory, CET1 buffer movement, single-name concentration, and the risk-tolerance bands the committee needs to set or affirm at this meeting.
objective: Equip the Risk Committee with a focused, evidence-based read on where the bank's risk position sits versus tolerance, so members can recalibrate limits and approve the mitigation plans queued for this meeting.
scope: Mara Heritage Bank — Risk Committee. Period: Q3 2025. Confidentiality: Restricted. Length: 5-8 pages.
